Register definitions for x64/x86 (+ AArch64 Xn/Wn/SP/XZR). Runtime codes match references/dynasm-rs/runtime/src/x64.rs, x86.rs and aarch64.rs.

Imports

types

Types

LabelRef = object
  case isLabel*: bool
  of true:
    lkind*: LabelRefKind
    lname*: string
    dynExpr*: string         ## placeholder, real expr handled in macro via id
    dynId*: int              ## resolved at macro expansion when possible
    loff*: int
  of false:
    nil
LabelRefKind = enum
  lrForward, lrBackward, lrGlobal, lrDynamic, lrAbsolute
MemOp = object
  hasBase*: bool
  base*: Register
  hasIndex*: bool
  index*: Register
  scale*: int
  disp*: int64
  hasDisp*: bool
  ripLabel*: LabelRef        ## for [glob(..)] / [fwd(..)] RIP-relative
  hasRip*: bool
  addrSizeOverride*: bool
Operand = object
  case kind*: OperandKind
  of okReg:
    reg*: Register
    regSize*: OpSize
  of okImm:
    imm*: int64
    immSize*: OpSize
  of okMem:
    mem*: MemOp
    memSize*: OpSize
  of okLabelRef:
    lbl*: LabelRef
OperandKind = enum
  okReg, okImm, okMem, okLabelRef
OpSize = enum
  szNone, sz8, sz16, sz32, sz64
RegClass = enum
  rcGpr,                    ## general purpose (size encoded separately)
  rcHigh8,                  ## AH/CH/DH/BH
  rcFpu,                    ## ST0..7
  rcMmx, rcXmm, rcSeg, rcControl, rcDebug, rcBound
Register = object
  code*: uint8
  cls*: RegClass
